operations.description: Remaining window and remaining count details, also returns reports that have been generated by this account.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] applications status [PARAMS] key [SCHEMA] application info report response status

operations.description: Output is ordered by Demographic and followed by Affinity information. For each data point the following metrics are provided value, count, mean, percentile, multiplicity and average. For Geographic, and Demographic data points an additional statistical_info metric will be present with information regarding statistical relevance.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] reports [PARAMS] baseline date hash report sample [SCHEMA] 18 24 25 34 35 404 44 age combined error female male report response sex success

operations.description: Used to create a custom report. This report treats the list of ids or handles as the audience (not their followers as in the twitter report). To create follower or tweet reports other methods must be used.

operations.description: This report details the audience of the users who have tweeted content that matches what was provided in the keywords. To create custom or twitter reports other methods must be used.

operations.description: This report uses the twitter followers as the audience. To create custom or tweet reports other methods must be used. Any report older than two days will be automatically regenerated upon create.

operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] reports twitter create [PARAMS] filter handle id twitter [SCHEMA] create follower response twitter
